verdict.rationale: There is no documented self-serve export button or open-format (e.g. CSV) audience download. A founder could assemble an export themselves using an API key for their own account. That would mean paging through cursor-paginated list endpoints for custom fields and pulling subscribers and tags via the API or the Kit MCP. Per-broadcast engagement stats are also available, but that is a build-it-yourself workaround rather than a portable export. Missing for 10: a native one-click audience export in an open format, per-subscriber engagement history export, suppression/unsubscribe list export, documented subscriber list/tag export endpoints, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
